description: STORAGE OPTIONS: Available storage variants - 256 GB to store all your photos, videos, and apps with ample space. VERSATILE SMARTPHONE: Perfect for photography, gaming, multitasking, and everyday use with Google's advanced mobile technology. GOOGLE ECOSYSTEM: Seamlessly integrates with Google services and features the latest Android operating system for optimal performance. BRAND RELIABILITY: Built by Google with their signature commitment to quality, security features, and regular software updates. Pixel is easy to switch to, and it comes with the best of Google. Pixel 8a includes 3 months of YouTube Premium, 3 months of Google One for new users, and 6 months of Fitbit Premium for new and returning users to help you get the most out of your new Pixel. Google One keeps your photos and files safe with 100 GB of storage and automatic phone backup. And with YouTube Premium, you can enjoy YouTube videos and music without ads, in the background, and offline. Give your motivation a healthy boost with 6 months of Fitbit Premium wellness content, including workouts, mindfulness sessions, healthy recipes, and more Help Make Calls Clearer Phone calls are easier with Pixel. With Clear Calling, Pixel reduces your caller’s background noise and enhances their voice. So you can hear them when they’re in a crowded or noisy place Save Time and Do More with Google AI Pixel with Google AI makes it easy to get things done. Ask Gemini, your built-in AI assistant, to summarise an email or Google Doc. Search for something just by circling it – an image or text, even in a video – right from the app you’re in. Google AI finds it fast. Write messages quickly using your voice with Assistant voice typing. Send messages in multiple languages with Live Translate. And at a Glance shows useful info right when you need it, like travel updates, event tickets, and more.
